Daily Devotional

June 19

16 So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth. 17 Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked: (Revelation 3:16-17 KJV)

This is where the Lord is writing to the Pastor of the Church at Laodicea (Revelation 3:14) through the Apostle John, when John had the experience that caused him to write the book of Revelation. Notice that the Lord is saying that He hates His servants being lukewarm, as He would rather we be either hot or cold, but not lukewarm. I believe this is telling us not to be indifferent or complacent in our service to God. We tend to get in a rut, and lose our zeal for the Word sometimes, and that is what the Lord hates. We need to stay in the Word, and become disciples indeed (John 8:31).

Is this not what the Church is experiencing now, as we have gotten spoiled, with large buildings, and all the modern electronics? Even though the Lord has blessed us greatly with so much in the way of stuff, the Church has lost most of its zeal and excitement for the Word of God. Religion in general does not want to teach about the Spiritual Gifts (1 Corinthians 12:8-10), and provide the healing power of God, as well as all the other benefits that the Lord has provided us. But has chosen to just preach on salvation by forgiveness of sins, and leave the rest of the Gospel out of our Churches. This causes us to be wretched, miserable, poor, blind and naked in our spirits. I sure don’t want Jesus to spue me out, so I am going to stay red hot for Him – Praise God.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
